searchConsole.title: Google Search Console
searchConsole.premiumOnly: Search Console intelligence is available on PREMIUM and CUSTOM plans with the integration enabled.
searchConsole.connectTitle: Connect real performance to your content strategy
searchConsole.connectDescription: Topiqu requests read-only access and uses the data for article metrics and optimization recommendations.
searchConsole.noProperty: Choose a site in Search Console
searchConsole.chooseProperty: Which website belongs to this project?
searchConsole.autopilotDescription: Opt in to automatic title and excerpt rewrites for articles with a low click-through rate, and to focused content refreshes. At most one article is changed per day, with a 7-day article cooldown and 30 days for the same article-query pair. Scheduled new articles use uncovered search demand and still follow your publishing settings.
searchConsole.rollbackSuccess: The last autonomous change was reverted.

provisioning.continueHelp: Connection is not ready yet. Review the current step above and continue with Check connection. Your current blog address stays unchanged.

guidance.ownership: Add the permanent Topiqu TXT and routing CNAME below, then check the connection. Keep both records while using this domain.
guidance.records: Topiqu ownership passed. Add the additional Cloudflare records below without replacing the Topiqu TXT. Multiple TXT values at the same name can coexist. Then check again.
guidance.https: Topiqu ownership passed. HTTPS is being prepared. Check again shortly; additional DNS records may appear below.
guidance.routing: HTTPS is ready. We are checking that this domain reaches your blog. Keep the DNS records and check again shortly.
guidance.activate: All connection checks passed. Use Verify and switch below to make this your blog’s main address.
guidance.active: This is your blog’s active address. Keep the permanent Topiqu TXT and routing CNAME. You can find the exact values in DNS instructions.
guidance.retry: The connection needs attention. Follow the warning above, then check again. Your DNS instructions and completed setup are retained; you do not need to restart.

dns.keep: Keep these two records for as long as you use this domain. If removed, restore these exact values; a missing Topiqu TXT can eventually suspend the connection.
dns.additional: These are additional records currently returned by Cloudflare. Add all displayed values; do not replace the permanent records. HTTPS can also validate automatically through routing.
dns.historyHelp: Cloudflare no longer requests these exact values. They are shown for reference, not as a verified status or an instruction to add them again. Current requirements are above.
dns.name: DNS name / host

provisioning.cleanupHelp: The blog has moved off this domain. Complete the disconnection before connecting it again. Manual provider configuration is retained.
provisioning.certificateRequirements: Use a publicly trusted certificate for this exact hostname only. Wildcards, additional hostnames and self-signed certificates are not supported.
provisioning.cleanupRequired: Disconnect domain integrations before permanently deleting this blog. Retained cleanup records require administrator review.
provisioning.expiringNotification: The origin certificate for {domain} expires soon. Install a replacement in domain settings.
provisioning.degradedNotification: The connection for {domain} is degraded. Review domain settings.
provisioning.revokedNotification: Serving {domain} has been suspended after repeated verification failures. Review domain settings.
provisioning.proxyHelp: Keep the Topiqu TXT record in DNS. Cloudflare proxy is supported after activation.
provisioning.disconnectConfirm: Switch to the selected Topiqu subdomain and disconnect this domain? Cleanup may take a few minutes.
provisioning.adoptConfirm: Attach the matching manual configuration? It stays externally managed and will not be deleted automatically.
provisioning.certificateHelp: Upload the PEM chain and matching unencrypted key. This secures the origin; Cloudflare manages the public certificate. Renewal is your responsibility.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.description: Notify Zapier, Make or your own server the moment an article is published, updated or removed.
webhooks.benefitOne: Mirror articles to any CMS without a dedicated integration.
webhooks.benefitTwo: Every request is signed, retried for about 15 hours and logged.
webhooks.stepOne: Paste an HTTPS endpoint from Zapier, Make or your server.
webhooks.stepTwo: Choose the events and copy the signing secret.
webhooks.stepThree: Send a test request to check the connection.
webhooks.limit: You can add up to {max} webhooks.
webhooks.secretOnce: Copy it now. It will not be shown again.
webhooks.rotateConfirm: Requests signed with the old secret will stop verifying. Continue?
webhooks.deleteConfirm: Delete this webhook? Undelivered requests are dropped.
webhooks.verifyHint: Verify the Topiqu-Signature header: v1 is the HMAC-SHA256 of the timestamp t, a dot and the raw body, keyed with your secret.

integrationsCatalog.title: Integrations
integrationsCatalog.description: Connect Topiqu to services for measurement, distribution, and publishing.
integrationsCatalog.noResultsDescription: Try changing the search term or selected plan.
integrationsCatalog.proDescription: Available on the Pro and Premium plans.
integrationsCatalog.premiumDescription: Advanced integrations available on the Premium plan.
integrationsCatalog.gscDescription: Turn search performance into concrete content opportunities.
integrationsCatalog.gscBenefitOne: See article queries, clicks, click-through rate and average positions.
integrationsCatalog.gscBenefitTwo: Topiqu finds content just below the top positions and articles that get few clicks in results.
integrationsCatalog.gscStepOne: Connect a Google account with Search Console access.
integrationsCatalog.gscStepTwo: Choose the site that belongs to this project.
integrationsCatalog.gscStepThree: Topiqu starts syncing finalized performance data every day.
integrationsCatalog.analyticsDescription: Add your own GA4 measurement to the website published by Topiqu.
integrationsCatalog.analyticsBenefitOne: Traffic data stays in your own Google Analytics account.
integrationsCatalog.analyticsBenefitTwo: Enable measurement without editing templates or source code.
integrationsCatalog.analyticsStepOne: In Google Analytics, open Admin → Data streams.
integrationsCatalog.analyticsStepTwo: Copy the Measurement ID in the G-XXXXXXXXXX format.
integrationsCatalog.analyticsStepThree: Enable measurement, enter the ID, and save your changes.
integrationsCatalog.gamDescription: Serve ads from your own Google Ad Manager (GAM) account on article pages.
integrationsCatalog.gamBenefitOne: Ad revenue stays in your own GAM account.
integrationsCatalog.gamBenefitTwo: The banner renders in the article's right column with no template changes.
integrationsCatalog.gamStepOne: In Google Ad Manager, create the /article/sidebar ad unit.
integrationsCatalog.gamStepTwo: Configure the GAM privacy message for this website's domain.
integrationsCatalog.gamStepThree: Enter the Network Code and save your changes.
integrationsCatalog.gamConsentNote: Ads load only for visitors who allow the Marketing category in cookie settings.
integrationsCatalog.linkedinDescription: Publish approved content to your personal LinkedIn profile.
integrationsCatalog.linkedinBenefitOne: Approved posts go straight to your personal profile.
integrationsCatalog.linkedinBenefitTwo: Human in the Loop keeps approval control before publishing.
integrationsCatalog.linkedinStepTwo: Grant Topiqu the requested LinkedIn access.
integrationsCatalog.linkedinStepThree: Configure the publishing mode and brand guidelines.
integrationsCatalog.shopifyBenefitOne: Articles go live on your store blog and stay editable from the editor.
integrationsCatalog.shopifyBenefitTwo: Products and collections are imported into Knowledge, so articles recommend what you actually sell.
integrationsCatalog.shopifyStepOne: Install the Topiqu app from the Shopify App Store.
integrationsCatalog.shopifyStepTwo: Open it in your store admin.
integrationsCatalog.developerDescription: Tools for custom development and publishing workflows outside the external services catalog.
integrationsCatalog.apiBenefitOne: Connect a custom app, automation, or editorial workflow.
integrationsCatalog.apiBenefitTwo: Regenerate the single secure access key whenever needed.
integrationsCatalog.wordpressDescription: Topiqu Sync imports published articles as native WordPress posts.
integrationsCatalog.wordpressBenefitOne: Move published content without manual copying.
integrationsCatalog.wordpressBenefitTwo: Articles remain native WordPress posts on your website.
integrationsCatalog.wordpressStepOne: Install and activate the Topiqu Sync plugin in WordPress.
integrationsCatalog.wordpressStepTwo: Enter your Topiqu URL and the API key from this page.
integrationsCatalog.wordpressStepThree: Test the connection and configure the synchronization interval.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe from email notifications
unsubscribe.intro: Once you confirm, we will stop emailing you about comments, replies and moderation. Sign-in and security emails will still arrive.
unsubscribe.done: Email notifications are off. You can turn them back on in your account settings at any time.

shopify.description: Publish articles from Topiqu to your Shopify blog and update them from the editor.
shopify.notConfigured: Shopify integration is not available yet.
shopify.requiresPlan: Shopify is available with Pro and Premium.
